claim.en: In 2022 Dominik Imrich, a Slovak national-team karate competitor, reached the bronze-medal bout in men's kumite up to 60 kg at the 57th European Championships in Gaziantep.
claim.sk: V roku 2022 sa slovenský karatistický reprezentant Dominik Imrich prebojoval na 57. majstrovstvách Európy v Gaziantepe do súboja o bronz v kumite mužov do 60 kg.

findings.identity: Slovak karate national-team competitor named Dominik Imrich; the candidate is a 28-year-old karate representative from Liptovský Hrádok (Aktuality.sk search result ties him to Liptovský Hrádok).
findings.quote: Slovenský reprezentant v karate Dominik Imrich zabojuje na 57. majstrovstvách Európy v tureckom Gaziantepe o bronzovú medailu v kumite mužov do 60 kg.
findings.title: ME: Slovenský karatista Dominik Imrich zabojuje o bronz
